description: Add source records for, and then link, the editions Waller 2022 cites for seven bowls known to the corpus only by their Table of Distribution designation (printed pp. 159-161): IM 76752 = Faraj 2021; IM 141803 = Faraj 2010; IM 212093 = Al-Jubouri 2015; M 5 = Shaked 1999: 194; MS 2053/7 = Bohak 2012: 47; MS 2053/236 = Bohak 2012: 48-59; JNF 124 = Ford 2016: 153-154.
resolution_notes: Held from the 2026-09-27 Waller publication-link batch. Five cited works have no source record: Faraj 2021 (ARAM 33), Al-Jubouri 2015 (Semitica 57), Shaked 1999 (Poetics of Spells, Mesopotamian Magic), Bohak 2012 (From Qumran to Cairo, Ritual Healing) and Ford 2016 (Eretz-Israel 32). IM 141803's 'Faraj 2010' is ambiguous between the Coppe magiche monograph and the Udine proceedings article, and the article exists only as two unreconciled discovery records. Bohak 2012's cited pp. 48-59 run past its listed pp. 31-52. Verify each work's bibliographic record at its publisher or library catalogue before adding it; do not infer a no-known-edition disposition.
